headline: JPMorgan analyst warns of potential data center investment risks post-2028
summary: JPMorgan's Michael Cembalest expressed concerns regarding the sustainability of data center infrastructure build-outs following the midterm elections, suggesting the true test for AI-related capital expenditure will emerge around 2028.
why: Data centers are the physical infrastructure underpinning the artificial intelligence boom, requiring massive capital investment from technology firms. Analysts monitor these expenditures to gauge the long-term profitability and growth sustainability of the AI sector.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Concerns over future capital expenditure levels may impact investor sentiment toward AI-heavy technology stocks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Market participants closely track capital expenditure forecasts for AI infrastructure, as these investments are a primary driver of current valuation premiums in the technology sector.
